versions.changelog:
- Documentation was updated for clarity, adding a quick "Start on APIDot" section with direct entry points.
- Minor wording adjustments to improve onboarding and task routing guidance.
- No new code or execution features were added; the skill remains documentation-only.
- The redundant skill-card.md file was removed.

Initial release: documentation-only routing and guidance for APIDot Kling O3 Image API workflows.

- Provides usage, security, workflow, and integration notes for Kling O3 Image API via APIDot.
- Routes user requests to official APIDot docs, model pages, and relevant support resources.
- No scripts, API clients, automation, or live API/network actions included.
- Emphasizes secret handling, async task management, and webhook integration.
- Includes local, non-executable references for request planning and model selection.
